profile.headline: Software Engineer at Bloomberg
profile.summary:
Recent grad from the University of Kansas with a degree in Computer Engineering.
Check out my website @ cheddydev.com

company.name: University of Kansas - School of Engineering

positions.title: EECS Shop Staff
positions.description: Milled and printed circuit boards for EECS classes. Trained and supported other student workers.

positions.title: EECS Shop Worker
positions.description: Distributed probe kits, electronic components, and equipment for engineering labs. Communicated with faculty and students concerning service issues, troubleshooting, and other various problems.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Developed a modern full stack application on an agile team with Angular, ASP.NET Web APIs, and Azure Maps to visualize gas flow data across the United States for the gas scheduling and operations teams. Designed the physical and logical architectures for the product.

positions.title: Voice & Video Engineering Intern
positions.description: Built full stack applications using Flask and JavaScript from the ground up for the voice and video departments to automate operational functions and provide valuable data insights.
